column3: Not every connection deserves rescuing, least of all the one you keep auditing. Two yeses would outwork the hoping; the hope is on layby, pouring anyway.
The wheel was never aimed at you, though you apologised to it. Open the laptop, do the dread thing, before the comfort raises the rent again.
The blank page is an exit, not an enemy. Order the unadventurous thing and enjoy it without performing. The quiet one has been the loud one for years, in a good way, briefly.
Back your own call this once. Keep tending the unglamorous middle. Healing zigzags; that is not the same as quitting.
Some staircases go down, and this one has a sofa on it. Pour into yourself before the next pour. The weak one arrived with a timeline; keep the receipt.
Let the ruin be a ruin; you are free of it. You are owed rest and you have been paying it out to strangers. Good news is routing; refuel uncheerfully, that is fine.
Steady hands, quiet engine, whole strategy. Make the thing even if the draft is deliberately ugly. The record speaks quietly and wins loudly, today, in your favour.
The borrowed energy has a visible lender. Repot the truth; it has been bound since spring. The number is called twice, and you can leave the biscuits.
Stop arm-wrestling the obvious; it has been to therapy. Nerve, spent now, all of it at once. The chain does not glitter anymore, only the habit does.
Zombie plans need a eulogy, not another attempt. The retreat became the residence and the rent is light. Raise it for the survivors of the week, including you.
Play the useless thing with commitment. Nobody in the call knows your face; the weighing happens regardless, and today your name is on the fair side.
You reset the counter and called it strength. The treat is now architecture. What fell was smiling for years; the rubble is free, and the light in it is excellent.
